text:
yuna: Heads-up: onboarding Asterion-v1 (int4 fast-profile) on staging showed regression on multi-locale evals. zh->en BLEU dropped from 30.2 (fp16) to 26.0 (int4). he->en and ar->en both down ~3.2-3.8 pts. Need quick triage.
yuna: Repro command I used:
```
python eval/run_translate.py --model asterion-v1 --quant int4 --dataset bench/xx_to_en_1k.jsonl --batch 16
```
yuna: Short n-example showing spacing/punct issues (Chinese):
```
src: 他说：“我会走。”
fp16: He said, "I'll go."
int4: He said , " I ' ll go . "
```
yuna: Arabic/hebrew samples show bracket ordering flips and missing RTL isolation marks around embedded latin.

omar: Hmm. Could be detok normalization or fast utf8 path in int4 kernel. Any kernel tag on the canary?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build for asterion-int4 used kernel tag `kernels/unicode-fast-1` deployed 2026-03-19T09:40Z. Tokenizer package unchanged.

fei: I ran tokenization+detok trace for the Chinese example. Token ids match fp16/int4 for the snippet, but detok logs show: "norm: collapse U+200D" and "norm: insert space before U+3002" on int4 path.

rachel: Collapsing U+200D (ZWJ) would break CJK joining and some Arabic ligatures. Inserting space before IDEOGRAPHIC FULL STOP (U+3002) is suspicious. Is the kernel doing a language-agnostic spacing rule?

omar: Good catch. If the fast path treats certain codepoints as punctuation boundaries aggressively, that explains both stray spaces and bracket reflows for RTL. Does the kernel expose a preserve/compat mode?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: No runtime flag was set in the canary. Previous stable int4 used `kernels/unicode-stable`. `unicode-fast-1` enabled micro-optimizations: zwj/zwnj collapse and ascii-first spacing heuristics.

fei: Quick test: re-run int4 with env TEXT_NORMALIZE=preserve on staging server 3. Ran a 1k eval: zh->en BLEU = 30.0 (nearly recovered). ar->en and he->en also within 0.2 pts of fp16.

yuna: That points to normalization policy in the kernel as root cause.

rachel: I'll open an issue against kernels repo documenting failing cases (CJK ZWJ, ZWNJ, RLI/LRI retention, IDEOGRAPHIC punctuation spacing, bidi bracket ordering). Will attach minimal repros and detok logs.

omar: Short-term mitigation: pin int4 canary to `kernels/unicode-stable` and block `unicode-fast-1` for production. Long-term: add integration tests in eval harness that include: ZWJ/ZWNJ, RLI/LRI, nested parentheses with mixed RTL/Latin, ideographic punctuation spacing.

fei: I'll add a test fixture `eval/fixtures/locale_control_chars.jsonl` with ~20 targeted cases and wire it into the canary job.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback to `kernels/unicode-stable` started 2026-03-19T10:05Z for canary group canary-a.

yuna: Thanks. Action items: rachel open kernel bug + attach logs; fei add eval fixtures & canary gating test; omar/infra pin rollback and add blocking gate; ops-bot monitor canary metrics.

rachel: PRs/issue references will be posted here. Adding :eyes: and tagging the kernels owners.

omar: One more ask - add a lightweight smoke check in the runtime that fails if detok path emits "removed U+200D" or similar for production locale sets. That will catch accidental optimizations.

fei: Will implement smoke and a small histogram in telemetry to count dropped control codepoints per language.

yuna: Great. Keep updates here and ping me for release decision.
